message: Hey Jane! I heard there might be an alumni event coming up soon. Do you have any details on that? I'd love to get it on my calendar early!
Jane, remember to keep the social gathering date under wraps until we finalize everything. We don't want to cause any confusion.
Looking forward to our meeting next month to decide on the final date for the alumni gathering. It's going to be a great event!
Can't wait to see the turnout for this year's social! Last year's was fantastic.
Missed you at the fundraiser, Jane! Hope everything is going well. Let's catch up soon.
Sorry to miss it, Emily! I was caught up with work. Will definitely catch up soon.
I'm out of town but heard the fundraiser is happening today. Hope it goes well!
Thanks, Emily! We'll miss you here. I'll let you know how it goes.
Reminder: The Green Meadows Annual Fundraiser is today! We look forward to seeing our alumni there and appreciate your support.
Can't wait for the fundraiser tomorrow. Hope to see many alumni there!
